description: Use this when the user asks about one clinical trial by its registry number (NCT, ISRCTN, ChiCTR, CTRI, CTIS and others): its design, outcomes and dates, every change recorded and the papers that cite it. Show a WHO ICTRP record with its attribution and the day WHO processed it.

nct_id.description: The trial's registry number as any registry or paper writes it (NCT04488601, ISRCTN12345678, CTRI/2024/01/012345, EU CT 2024-512345-12-00), or a link to its record in the registry.

name: get_trial
